description: Compare user-supplied distinct owned names with one verified series. Returns owned, not-marked-owned, explicit wanted names, unmatched inputs and a copyable Markdown checklist. Does not assume missing means wanted, infer quantities or trade intent, certify a complete set, or access browser storage. Use exact names from search_collection_series. Supplied lists are processed remotely but not saved by the tool.

language.description: Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE.

owned.description: Exact figure names from the selected series. Distinct styles only; repeated input names do not establish owned quantities or trade offers.

wanted.description: Only figures the user explicitly wants. Omit or pass [] when not specified; unowned figures are never added automatically.

name: prepare_collection_checklist
